title: [IMP-12] Set up engineering source and drawing-review forms
description:
Source task
PPAP implementation plan / IMP-12

Source plan
docs/phase 2/ppap/solution_specification/implementation-plan.json; plan date 2026-11-17; SHA-256 16059e862dd86c29ccbe374cabe8c001bbdab4667e74f46dadf2122b8f479d54

Task ID
IMP-12

Title
Set up engineering source and drawing-review forms

Category
Fields and forms

Objective
Keep released engineering evidence and the initial SIA review available before a PPAP exists.

Detailed scope
Add Engineering Release/Part and Drawing Review fields/forms, including source keys, explicit unknown classifications, correction lineage, exact routing context and released-specification reference. Provide restricted manual preparation controls without issuing PPAP directly.

Deliverable
Operational source and initial-review forms with clear provenance and read-only accepted content.

Work needed first
IMP-01 — Create the PPAP Objects and workflow stages
IMP-02 — Set up PPAP reference lists and operating settings

What the earlier tasks provide
• IMP-01 provides the new Objects, native stage/termination identities and target-record marker.
• IMP-02 provides the seven governed lists and operating-policy fields/default entries.

What is waiting
Partly waiting: known scalar fields and internal layouts can proceed; external record references, routing selections and released-specification selector wait for their supplied identifiers.

Recommended implementer role
Senior Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
The assignment combines established field, related-list and form settings. A Senior Associate Consultant can apply the conditions consistently, with the separate build reviewer checking their effect on the wider process.

Fields and features to set up
PPAP Engineering Release.Source System
Set the type to Text; up to 100 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Integration service or restricted intake administrator; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Canonical source-system identifier supplied by separate operational connection. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release.Source Release Key
Set the type to Text; up to 255 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Integration service or restricted controlled-manual intake; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Stable upstream event/release identity; never infer revision ordering from ECS number. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release.ECS Number
Set the type to Text; up to 100 characters. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Integration service; restricted manual intake with source evidence; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Identifier for provenance, not an ordinal revision. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release.Drawing Number
Set the type to Text; up to 100 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Integration service or controlled-manual intake; fixed after acceptance; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Validate source mapping before initial review creation. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release.Drawing Revision Code
Set the type to Text; up to 100 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Integration service or controlled-manual intake; fixed after acceptance; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Explicit revision identity; no numeric inference. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release.Drawing Release Date
Set the type to Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Integration service or controlled manual intake; fixed after acceptance; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Authoritative calendar release date anchors initial drawing review plus 14 days. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release.Drawing Revision
Create a link to Operational Drawing Revision, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Integration service or authorized mapping administrator; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Separate operational adapter resolves governed type/key; unresolved mapping stays in native integration diagnostics, no unvalidated review generation. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release.Change Type
Create a link to PPAP Type, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Operational integration or controlled intake administrator before acceptance; new selection filters Active?=TRUE; preserve existing inactive references read only; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Source change-context mapping determines correct internal SIA PPAP Engineer role; fixed after acceptance. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release.Routing Entity
Create a link to Supplier Abstract, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Operational integration or controlled mapping administrator before acceptance; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Exact authoritative supplier entity for initial-review role resolution; missing mapping stays owned intake work, never defaults creator; fixed after acceptance. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release.Candidate Manufacturing Facilities
Create the native multiple-selection link to Supplier Facility (M:N); inverse disabled. Use native link storage without a new Object. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: Source-approved operational supplier crosswalk. Who can use it and when: Integration or controlled mapping administrator before acceptance; authorized internal users only; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Retain source candidates for PPAP Draft facility selection; not an approved scope and never role membership fallback; fixed after acceptance. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release.Manual Intake?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: FALSE. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Controlled manual creation sets TRUE and requires source evidence; automated reconciliation matches same governed release identity, does not generate another review. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release.Content Fingerprint
Set the type to Text; up to 64 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Integration computes SHA-256 of agreed governed semantic payload. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Payload canonicalization/transport mapping requires interface agreement; replay same identity+fingerprint is safe to run again without duplicates, conflicting content uses controlled source-correction route. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release.Corrects Release
Create a link to PPAP Engineering Release, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Integration service or controlled intake administrator before acceptance; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Only a genuine source correction to same source event/drawing revision; preserve both fixed contexts. New engineering change never uses this field to absorb into older PPAP. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release.Source Evidence
Use the Intelex native attachment collection, retaining file identity, name, length and content type. Do not create a custom file table. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Integration service or intake administrator before accept; read only after acceptance; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Retain original source/file evidence; no automatic deletion; native execution logs own retry diagnostics. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release.Accepted At
Set the type to Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Accept Release handler stamps only after full release+part graph validation; no partial accepted graph. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release Part.Engineering Release
Create a link to PPAP Engineering Release, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP Engineering Release.Parts. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Integration service or intake administrator before acceptance; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Unique Engineering Release+Part governed identity. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release Part.Part
Create a link to Operational Part, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Integration maps; restricted administrator resolves authoritative mapping; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Accepted graph requires governed operational part; no isolated API-object relationship. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release Part.Part Number
Set the type to Text; up to 100 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Authoritative source part number. Who can use it and when: Integration service before acceptance; fixed afterward; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Original semantic source path recorded by interface mapping; PPAP selection snapshots it. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release Part.Part Description
Set the type to Text; up to 255 characters. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: Authoritative source description or NULL. Who can use it and when: Integration service before acceptance; fixed afterward; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Copied to PPAP Part for historical scope. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release Part.Important Safety?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL until explicit TRUE or FALSE from authority. Who can use it and when: Integration service only; no PPAP editing; incomplete source may enter review/draft, never Issue; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Preserve unknown/conflict in source preparation diagnostics; all three explicit flags required at PPAP Issue. Source correction creates controlled accepted context and impacts only matching issued original context. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release Part.Important Quality?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL until explicit TRUE or FALSE from authority. Who can use it and when: Integration service only; no PPAP editing; incomplete source may enter review/draft, never Issue; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Preserve unknown/conflict in source preparation diagnostics; all three explicit flags required at PPAP Issue. Source correction creates controlled accepted context and impacts only matching issued original context. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Engineering Release Part.Regulated?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL until explicit TRUE or FALSE from authority. Who can use it and when: Integration service only; no PPAP editing; incomplete source may enter review/draft, never Issue; fixed after Engineering Release.Accepted At is populated. Field/control lifecycle: Preserve unknown/conflict in source preparation diagnostics; all three explicit flags required at PPAP Issue. Source correction creates controlled accepted context and impacts only matching issued original context. Corrections create controlled replacement source context; never overwrite an accepted release graph.

PPAP Drawing Review.Engineering Release
Create a link to PPAP Engineering Release, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP Engineering Release.Drawing Reviews. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Accept Release creates one initial review per governed released SIA drawing context; replay/manual reconciliation cannot create duplicates.

PPAP Drawing Review.Responsible Engineer
Create a link to Employee, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Routing adapter resolves governed SIA PPAP Engineer; authorized intake administrator corrects missing route. Field/control lifecycle: Missing required assignment remains owned integration diagnostic and cannot silently assign creator.

PPAP Drawing Review.Routing Entity
Create a link to Supplier Abstract, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Accept Release copies Engineering Release.Routing Entity; exact-entity role resolution only.

PPAP Drawing Review.Change Type
Create a link to PPAP Type, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; new selection filters Active?=TRUE; preserve existing inactive references read only. Field/control lifecycle: Accept Release copies Engineering Release.Change Type; selects Operating Policy internal SIA PPAP Engineer role by stable Type.Code.

PPAP Drawing Review.Engineer Role
Create a link to Supplier Specific Role, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Accept Release resolves Routing Entity + policy Model/Running/Process Engineer Role; Responsible Engineer must be an eligible current member.

PPAP Drawing Review.Due Date
Set the type to Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Engineering Release.Drawing Release Date + Operating Policy.Drawing Review Days. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Accept Release calculates calendar date; past date warns, no holiday roll.

PPAP Drawing Review.Operating Policy
Create a link to PPAP Operating Policy, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Accept Release binds current policy; initial Due Date saved copy preserved.

PPAP Drawing Review.PPAP Required?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: TRUE. Who can use it and when: Responsible SIA PPAP Engineer while review open. Field/control lifecycle: No-PPAP decision requires active Exception Reason and mandatory rationale; new revision cannot be absorbed by an older PPAP.

PPAP Drawing Review.Exception Reason
Create a link to PPAP Drawing Review Exception Reason, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer when PPAP Required?=FALSE; hidden/NULL when TRUE; active values only; new selection filters Active?=TRUE; preserve existing inactive references read only. Field/control lifecycle: Save clears only before review closure if PPAP Required? returns TRUE; no-PPAP completion requires controlled source-backed reason.

PPAP Drawing Review.Decision Rationale
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer; mandatory if PPAP Required?=FALSE; retained on closure. Field/control lifecycle: Records governed exception or PPAP launch explanation; native workflow preserves decision.

PPAP Drawing Review.Already Created PPAP
Create a link to PPAP, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer may link only PPAP created for SAME governed source change and intended facility/scope. Field/control lifecycle: This is duplicate-link reconciliation only; never address a different engineering change using an existing open PPAP.

PPAP Drawing Review.Inspection Specification Review Required?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: TRUE. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer while review open. Field/control lifecycle: Initial review explicitly decides specification-review need; detailed spec version control stays in Product Management.

PPAP Drawing Review.Inspection Specification Disposition
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer; required to complete initial review; records linked spec-review outcome or routed work reference. Field/control lifecycle: Review completion does not auto-create pilot program or require all later inspection execution complete.

PPAP Drawing Review.Released Inspection Specification Version
Create a link to Released Inspection Specification Version, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer selects released version covering affected drawing/revision/parts; mandatory when Inspection Specification Review Required?=TRUE. Field/control lifecycle: Complete Drawing Review validates released status, correct scope and version binding; pending routed work/text alone cannot satisfy this checkpoint; NULL retained only when review not required with rationale.

PPAP Engineering Release.Parts
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Engineering Release Part.Engineering Release; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

PPAP Engineering Release.Drawing Reviews
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Drawing Review.Engineering Release; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

Build instructions
1. Keep source identity, drawing/revision, source evidence and every accepted release-part value read only after Accepted At is populated. A correction creates another accepted context linked through Corrects Release; it never edits the accepted graph in place.
2. Show important-safety, important-quality and regulated flags with NULL as unknown until the authority supplies explicit TRUE/FALSE. Missing flags may enter initial review/Draft, but expose no local PPAP override or false default.
3. For manual preparation require source evidence and the same canonical source/crosswalk fields as automated intake. Keep Candidate Manufacturing Facilities contextual rather than an approved scope or inherited role grant.
4. On review forms default PPAP Required?=TRUE. When FALSE require an active Exception Reason and Decision Rationale; returning TRUE before review closure clears the reason. Require an explicit inspection-specification disposition, and show the released-version selector when review is required.

How to check the result
• An accepted source record and its accepted parts cannot be changed through ordinary forms.
• Unknown classification remains empty rather than false; an unapproved free-text specification promise cannot replace the released-version link.

Information needed for this task
IN-02: Supply operational drawing/part/facility fields and source/routing mappings for external selectors. Known source text/date fields can proceed.
IN-05: Supply exact internal review role/person selection references and the approved manual-intake users.
IN-07: Supply the actual released inspection-specification version type/status/scope reference for the drawing-review selector.

Supplied input context
• IN-02 — Operational engineering data and record links: SIA and the operational Product Management owner must supply the separate BOMEX/ECS delivery contract, producer/event/revision keys, drawing and part object/field identifiers, facility/depot crosswalks, explicit classification authority/precedence, full/delta/correction/removal rules, source ordering, accepted release criteria and external endpoint/credentials. Source selectors, receipt and correction processing wait for these exact values; the isolated Product Integration application is not that connection.
• IN-05 — Approved SIA roles, supplier roles and capability rules: The SRM/security owners must supply the governed library-role and exact-entity role identifiers, populated memberships, SIA engineer selections, inspection teams/leaders, management approver pool and PPAP administrator group. They must also supply central ACTIVE/SERVICE/INACTIVE capability identifiers and reconcile the annotated central open-work transition rule. These are existing shared authorities; membership administration and central policy decisions are outside the build assignments.
• IN-07 — Released inspection specifications and result evidence: The Product Management/Inspection owners must supply released-specification and result object/field identifiers, valid released states and scope keys, and an immutable result-version reference or controlled result-artifact export. Required review/result checks and links wait for those values; measurements and specification publishing remain external.

Specification references
• [Target PPAP technical specification](ppap-target-technical-specification.md)
• [Canonical target field contract](ppap-target-field-contract.md)

Assumptions and open questions
New operational PPAPs only. SIA PPAP Engineer means an internal SIA user; supplier personnel act through their separate supplier roles.
